title: Lovely Molten Middle Eastern Cream Cheese Wrap
description: A charred and cozy Middle Eastern dish featuring cream cheese, perfect for a halal-friendly meal, the cream cheese is melted to a molten state and wrapped in a ssam-wrap.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a bowl, mix the softened cream cheese with sumac, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Brush the ssam wraps with olive oil on both sides.
Place a ssam wrap in the skillet and spread about 2 ounces of the cream cheese mixture onto the center of the wrap.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up to form a tight cylinder.
Cook the wrap for 2-3 minutes on each side, until it is charred and the cream cheese is melted.
Serve the wraps hot and enjoy.
